cycle: Inception — tranche 1, part 2 (catch-up after engine fix)
note: These five orders were part of the original opening deployment. They were wrongly rejected by a bug in engine/portfolio.py: newly bought positions were not being marked, so equity() counted only cash and the book value used by the position-size rule shrank with every purchase, inflating each subsequent order's computed weight. The rule was correct; the denominator was wrong. Fixed and covered by a regression test. Re-issuing at current market prices - NOT at the prices they would have filled at earlier, because pretending otherwise would flatter the track record.
